title: Scaling global relocation operations with nearshore talent
subhead: One of the world's leading relocation and mobility services companies needed top-tier operational and finance talent, fast, without US and European hiring costs.
challenge: Struggled to fill Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Staff Accountant and Global Accounting Manager roles despite competitive salaries.
Could not maintain adequate coverage in guest services and intercultural support.
Needed to scale internal teams without exceeding operational budgets.
Traditional hiring was too costly and too slow for roles requiring strong English fluency, cross-cultural understanding and financial precision.

solution.title: A blended nearshore team: accounting and finance specialists, an intercultural training coordinator, guest services and admin support
Every hire vetted for technical skill, cultural alignment and communication ability
solution.result: Full adoption of the client's own tools and workflows

results.label: Typical time to fill a role

quote: Partnering with Handoff has completely transformed how we scale our operational teams. When local hiring dried up, their team delivered high caliber talent fast, and at a fraction of the cost.
